profile_text.body:
Rackspace Technology is a public company founded in 1998 and headquartered in San Antonio, trading under the ticker RXT. On its own site, the company describes itself as a cloud computing services pioneer that delivers multicloud solutions across apps, data, and security. It says it has helped customers move from hosting to cloud to enterprise AI, and it presents itself as the trusted operator of the full enterprise AI stack, from governed private cloud to AI inference and agents in production.

The company says it assembles, integrates, and operates that stack and remains accountable for outcomes after deployment. It describes an Enterprise AI Cloud built on a secure, regulated, and compliant foundation using AI-optimized hardware, and says it works with best-of-breed partners across every layer of the stack to connect models, platform, and infrastructure into a governed system for regulated environments. It says its engineers embed directly in customer environments to build, deploy, and operate AI workloads in production, and it cites security, compliance, data sovereignty, and uptime as foundational. The site lists customers in Financial Services, Healthcare, and Government, and quotes Dr. Zafar Chaudry, MD, Senior VP, Chief Digital Officer and Chief AI and Information Officer at Seattle Children's Hospital.

The company's profile records a CIK of 0001810019. No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are listed for it.
